beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: In this town, everybody parties.
beats.visual: Crane down the party street.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Except me. DJ Hip Replacement. In bed by seven.
beats.visual: Gerald's bedroom: Gerald in bed in a nightcap next to a big alarm clock reading FRI 23:59.

beats.speaker: gerald
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!
beats.visual: The alarm clock rings; one snooze slam per HUSS; the clock jumps back each time.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: A balloon proposed to a cactus. Short wedding.
beats.visual: Street: a balloon kneels to a cactus in a pot; POP on 'Short'.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: While they're out partying, by the way, I'm pressing snooze.
beats.visual: Gerald's hand on the snooze button, again and again.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Then I snoozed the rooster. It's the pigeon.
beats.visual: The pigeon on the windowsill puffs to crow; Gerald presses a snooze button on its head.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Then I snoozed the sunrise.
beats.visual: The sun peeks over the hills outside the window; snooze; it sinks back.

beats.speaker: gerald
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!
beats.visual: One HUSS per bounce: the sun rises and drops back behind the hills.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Five more minutes never hurt anybody. The dinosaurs.

card.quote: Five more minutes never hurt anybody.

beats.visual: QUOTE CARD; attribution on 'The dinosaurs.'

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Then I snoozed Saturday.
beats.visual: A wall calendar page SATURDAY flips back to FRIDAY.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: The moon asked for a day off. Denied.
beats.visual: A tired moon over the town; DENIED stamp.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Top ten respectful moments. Number seven: the sun knocked first.
beats.visual: TOP 10 card; the sun politely knocks on the bedroom window.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Then the sun stopped knocking.
beats.visual: Silence. The sun outside the window, unsmiling, cracks its knuckles.

beats.speaker: gerald
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!
beats.visual: Gerald slams snooze six times; on each HUSS the sky over the town cracks wider.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: That's why in this town, everybody parties.
beats.visual: Crane over the cracked night sky to the party street.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: It's been Friday night since nineteen eighty two.
beats.visual: The square banner reads FRIDAY NIGHT / PARTY / 14.05.1982; tag 16,263 NIGHTS.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Grandad's conga line? Same night.
beats.visual: The conga line from ep7, Grandad at the back, tag SINCE 1982.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Good things come to those who wait. Saturday. Still waiting.

card.quote: Good things come to those who wait.

beats.visual: QUOTE CARD; reveal: a giant calendar page reading SATURDAY sits on a bench under a lamp, waiting.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Why? Saturday is my hip replacement.
beats.visual: Bedroom: an appointment card on the nightstand: SATURDAY 9AM — HIP REPLACEMENT.

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: It's not a DJ name. It's a reminder.
beats.visual: A sticky note on Gerald's forehead: DJ — HIP REPLACEMENT (the D J crossed out → 'DON'T forget').

beats.speaker: narr
beats.text: Five more minutes.
beats.visual: The clock flips to SAT 00:00 and rings; Gerald's hand creeps to the snooze button.

beats.speaker: gerald
beats.text: HUSS! HUSS! HUSS!
beats.visual: Three slams; the clock snaps back to FRI 23:59; outside the party roars back. Iris out.
